note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens in DEV. Uses the process mining 90-day trial already running in DEV (started 21 Nov 2026, until about 19 Feb 2027); no Azure resources, no extra cost. The 'kpis' screen is split: the browser on the left, a terminal pane on the right running the episode's own pmkit.
prepare: # owner signs in: browser profile for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com, environment DEV, private window). Nothing is typed or stored here.

screens.name: upload
steps: Select environment DEV and open Process mining > Start here
Name the process 'Purchase requests' and choose Import data
Choose a data source > Text/CSV > 'Upload file (Preview)' and select src\samples\purchase-requests-eventlog.csv (if the label differs, keep the real one and fix script.yaml)
Show the Power Query preview of the first rows
mask: org URL and environment ID in the address bar
user name and tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: mapping
steps: On the 'Map your data' screen set CaseId = Case ID, ActivityName = Activity name, StartTimestamp = Start timestamp, EndTimestamp = End timestamp, Resource = Resource
Set Amount = Financial per case (first event) and Category = Case level attribute (first event)
Show the 'Save and analyze' button, then select it (note any time zone warning)
mask: org URL and environment ID in the address bar
user name and tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: map
steps: Open the process 'Purchase requests' and its Map tab: nine activities
Select the Performance layer with Mean duration and highlight the long transition from Manager review to Finance review
Switch to the Rework layer and show the loop around Manager review and Revise request
mask: org URL and environment ID in the address bar
user name and tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: kpis
steps: Open the process 'Purchase requests' > Summary tab (left half of the screen)
Show the KPIs (average case duration, self-loop cases, loop cases, rework cases), Variants by frequency and the case, activity and variant counts
In a terminal pane on the right half run, from src: python -m pmkit analyze samples\purchase-requests-eventlog.csv --before "Manager review" "Place order"
Compare the two: 300 cases, 1,781 events, 17 variants, 227.2 h, 28.0 percent rework; say what the screen shows if the definitions differ
mask: org URL and environment ID in the address bar
user name and tenant name in the top bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): delete the process 'Purchase requests' and its uploaded data in Process mining; remove any trial licence assigned only for the recording
